name: TNF receptor associated factor 3
pathways: regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: TRAF3 encodes TNF receptor-associated factor 3. Annotated molecular activities include signaling adaptor activity and ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.
